pipeline-curation.claim_text: ML and LLM text mining can collate biological mechanisms and observable phenomena from the literature into a form usable by mechanistic-model builders.

candidates.paper_title: STRING v11: protein–protein association networks with increased coverage, supporting functional discovery in genome-wide experimental datasets

useful_outcomes.rationale: STRING aggregates curated PPI evidence across 5090 organisms via text mining and computational predictions, supplying mechanism inputs.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Public web/API at string-db.org with genome-wide upload supports immediate WCM curation use.

plausible.rationale: Mature, widely cited (~19k citations) integration of multiple evidence channels and benchmarked enrichment classifications.

scalable.rationale: Coverage doubled to 5090 organisms with genome-wide dataset upload, demonstrating scaling toward whole-cell complexity.

how_to_validate.rationale: Confidence scores and enrichment analysis guide validation, but no formal WCM-specific validation protocol.

candidates.paper_title: The STRING database in 2021: customizable protein–protein networks, and functional characterization of user-uploaded gene/measurement sets

useful_outcomes.rationale: Integrates text mining, experimental databases, co-expression, and cross-organism transfer for protein interaction curation.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Customizable user-uploaded gene/measurement sets directly usable for WCM mechanism curation.

plausible.rationale: Mature multi-source scoring approach with extensive citation track record (~8k).

scalable.rationale: Cross-organism transfer and database scope make it suitable for genome-scale model curation.

how_to_validate.rationale: Source-specific confidence scores enable filtering, but no built-in WCM validation strategy.

candidates.paper_title: The STRING database in 2023: protein–protein association networks and functional enrichment analyses for any sequenced genome of interest

useful_outcomes.rationale: Aggregates physical and functional protein interactions including text-mined evidence, suiting mechanism extraction for WCM builders.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Available for any sequenced genome of interest, immediately usable to seed organism-specific mechanisms.

plausible.rationale: Established curation workflow with strong scoring methodology and broad community adoption.

scalable.rationale: Designed to scale to any sequenced genome with automated text mining and computational predictions.

how_to_validate.rationale: Functional enrichment and confidence scores partially address validation but not WCM-specific.

candidates.paper_title: UniProt: the universal protein knowledgebase in 2021

useful_outcomes.rationale: Provides curated 190M-protein annotations with literature-extracted functional info, directly usable in WCM gene-product modules.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Open knowledgebase with the new ARBA automated annotator means immediate adoption is straightforward.

plausible.rationale: Long-standing community resource with rigorous expert curation plus rule-based automation.

scalable.rationale: 190M sequences and proteome completeness assessment scale beyond whole-cell needs.

how_to_validate.rationale: Reviewed/unreviewed status and credit-based evaluation give validation cues, but not a WCM-specific protocol.

candidates.paper_title: BioBERT: a pre-trained biomedical language representation model for biomedical text mining

useful_outcomes.rationale: Domain-adapted BERT directly enables NER, relation extraction, and QA on biomedical literature for mechanism harvesting.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Pre-trained weights are openly available and plug into standard NLP pipelines for immediate curation workflows.

plausible.rationale: Demonstrates measurable gains over generic BERT on biomedical NLP benchmarks via domain-specific pretraining.

scalable.rationale: Transformer architecture scales to large corpora; fine-tuning task overhead is the only friction.

how_to_validate.rationale: Reports task-level F1/accuracy on biomedical benchmarks but no curation-specific WCM validation pipeline.

candidates.paper_title: miRBase: annotating high confidence microRNAs using deep sequencing data

useful_outcomes.rationale: Curates 30,424 mature miRNAs across 206 species using deep-sequencing-based confidence levels useful for regulatory mechanism inputs.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Public mirbase.org database with confidence annotations is directly reusable, though scope is narrow (miRNAs only).

plausible.rationale: Sequencing-driven re-annotation methodology is well-described and community-trusted.

scalable.rationale: Scales across species but limited to miRNA submodule of any whole-cell model.

how_to_validate.rationale: Confidence levels provide validation hooks for downstream model builders.

candidates.paper_title: miRBase: from microRNA sequences to function

useful_outcomes.rationale: Maps 5.5B reads across 1493 datasets to validate miRNA annotations and add functional context for mechanistic use.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Disseminated functional info accessible online; ready for WCM regulatory module curation.

plausible.rationale: Read-mapping evidence supports 20-65% of annotations, with clear removal criteria.

scalable.rationale: 271 organisms supported, but covers only one regulatory class within a whole cell.

how_to_validate.rationale: Read-mapping statistics offer concrete validation evidence, transferable but narrow.

candidates.paper_title: High-throughput functional annotation and data mining with the Blast2GO suite

useful_outcomes.rationale: Automates functional annotation of DNA/protein sequences with GO terms, directly feeding WCM gene-product mechanism construction.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Biologist-oriented tool widely used for high-throughput functional annotation.

plausible.rationale: Mature method in the field with strong adoption and validation track record.

scalable.rationale: Designed for high-throughput sequence annotation, scaling to genome-wide datasets.

how_to_validate.rationale: Annotation scoring exists but pre-deep-learning era validation may need upgrading.

candidates.paper_title: BioGRID: a general repository for interaction datasets

useful_outcomes.rationale: Provides 116k+ curated physical/genetic interactions including 30k from exhaustive yeast literature curation, directly usable in mechanism graphs.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Free download as PSI-MI XML or tab-delimited text, plug-and-play for WCM builders.

plausible.rationale: Manual primary-literature curation gives high-confidence interaction data.

scalable.rationale: Covers 4 model organisms in this version; scaling needs broader curation effort.

how_to_validate.rationale: Source attribution per interaction enables provenance-based validation.

candidates.paper_title: The STRING database in 2011: functional interaction networks of proteins, globally integrated and scored

useful_outcomes.rationale: Earlier STRING release integrating experimental and computational PPI predictions for mechanistic curation.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Online resource was directly usable, though superseded by newer releases (EXT-031/032/033).

plausible.rationale: Established scoring system distinguishing experimental vs computational evidence.

scalable.rationale: Comprehensive coverage scaling toward systems-level modelling.

how_to_validate.rationale: Scored evidence channels provide partial validation framework.

pipeline-inference.claim_text: ML can infer parameters, latent states, and missing quantities for mechanistic models from heterogeneous omics datasets.

candidates.paper_title: Approximate Bayesian Computation

useful_outcomes.rationale: ABC bypasses likelihood evaluation, enabling parameter inference for complex models where analytical likelihoods are infeasible — directly applicable to WCM.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Mature method with established software, immediately adoptable for mechanistic model parameter fitting.

plausible.rationale: Foundational, well-grounded statistical method with broad theoretical support.

scalable.rationale: Classical ABC scales poorly with high-dimensional summary statistics, though approximations help.

how_to_validate.rationale: Posterior predictive checks and choice of summary statistics provide a clear validation strategy.

candidates.paper_title: Deep Learning for Population Genetic Inference

useful_outcomes.rationale: Likelihood-free deep learning learns features mapping summary statistics to population-genetic parameters — prototype for omics-driven inference.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Method demonstrated for population genetics; adapting to WCM omics requires re-architecting.

plausible.rationale: Demonstrated on a concrete selection/demography problem with quantitative success.

scalable.rationale: Multilayer networks scale to hundreds of correlated summaries; suitable for high-dim data.

how_to_validate.rationale: Simulation-based validation is implicit; cross-checks against ground-truth simulations are demonstrated.

candidates.paper_title: Real-Time Gravitational Wave Science with Neural Posterior Estimation

useful_outcomes.rationale: Neural posterior estimation reduces inference from days to 20s on LIGO data, illustrating amortized SBI gains transferable to WCM parameter inference.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Domain-specific to gravitational waves; WCM adoption needs significant retraining infrastructure.

plausible.rationale: Quantitatively matches standard MCMC on 8 events with massive speed gain.

scalable.rationale: Amortization makes it scale across many events once trained, suiting genome-scale repeat inferences.

how_to_validate.rationale: Validates against established Bayesian samplers — a transferable validation strategy.

candidates.paper_title: Bayesian inference of atomistic structure in functional materials

useful_outcomes.rationale: BOSS uses Bayesian active learning over atomistic energy landscapes — only loosely related to omics-driven WCM parameter inference.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Materials-science focus means significant adaptation needed for biological mechanistic models.

plausible.rationale: Demonstrated on molecular surface adsorption with active learning rigor.

scalable.rationale: Building-block approach offers some scaling, but not to whole-cell complexity.

how_to_validate.rationale: Surrogate-energy validation strategy is transferable but indirect for WCM.

candidates.paper_title: Detecting adaptive introgression in human evolution using convolutional neural networks

useful_outcomes.rationale: CNNs trained on simulated genomic data identify introgressed variants — example of ML mapping omics to evolutionary parameters.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Specific to introgression detection; WCM adaptation requires reframing the inference problem.

plausible.rationale: Outperforms alternative methods in classification and parameter estimation per simulation benchmarks.

scalable.rationale: CNN approach scales over genome regions but limited to sequence-data inference.

how_to_validate.rationale: Simulation-based training provides ground-truth validation transferable in principle.

candidates.paper_title: Neural Importance Sampling for Rapid and Reliable Gravitational-Wave Inference

useful_outcomes.rationale: Combines amortized neural posterior estimation with importance sampling for corrected, diagnosed posteriors — directly applicable methodology to mechanistic inference.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Method is general but demonstrated on GW data; transferring to WCM needs adapting forward models.

plausible.rationale: Provides bias-free posteriors plus sample-efficiency diagnostic; addresses common deep-learning concerns.

scalable.rationale: Amortized scheme scales to 42 events analyzed; same paradigm scales for repeated WCM inferences.

how_to_validate.rationale: Sample efficiency diagnostic and importance-weighted correction are explicitly designed for validation.

candidates.paper_title: OutbreakFlow: Model-based Bayesian inference of disease outbreak dynamics with invertible neural networks and its application to the COVID-19 pandemics in Germany

useful_outcomes.rationale: Couples mathematical epidemiological model with invertible neural networks for amortized parameter inference — archetypal pipeline ML→MM use case.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Two-phase train-then-infer workflow is reproducible and adaptable for WCM ODE models.

plausible.rationale: Successfully applied to real COVID-19 German data with mechanistic SIR-type model.

scalable.rationale: Amortization makes inference cheap on new data; scaling to many parameters requires architecture care.

how_to_validate.rationale: Posterior calibration diagnostics from BayesFlow approach are transferable validation tools.

candidates.paper_title: A forward modeling approach to analyzing galaxy clustering with SimBIG
candidates.paper_journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

useful_outcomes.rationale: Simulation-based inference with normalizing flows on 20k forward-model simulations — methodology transferable to WCM but cosmology domain.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Astrophysics-specific; adapting requires WCM-quality forward simulator and survey realism analog.

plausible.rationale: Built on 2000 high-fidelity Quijote N-body sims with detailed survey realism.

scalable.rationale: SBI with normalizing flows handles high-dim summary statistics, suiting omics scale.

how_to_validate.rationale: Standard cosmology comparisons demonstrate SBI calibration — transferable validation pattern.

candidates.paper_title: Methods and considerations for estimating parameters in biophysically detailed neural models with simulation based inference

useful_outcomes.rationale: Directly applies SBI to estimate parameters in biophysically detailed neural models, addressing the no-likelihood challenge identical to WCM.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Practical methods/considerations paper aimed at practitioners using openly available neural models — immediately portable.

plausible.rationale: Methodologically rigorous Bayesian SBI on established detailed mechanistic neuron models.

scalable.rationale: Scales toward complex biophysical models; whole-cell scale would require extensions but the paradigm fits.

how_to_validate.rationale: Explicitly addresses identifiability and posterior validation considerations — a near-direct WCM-builder template.

candidates.paper_title: Disordered Heterogeneous Universe: Galaxy Distribution and Clustering across Length Scales

useful_outcomes.rationale: Applies disordered-media statistics to galaxy distributions; no ML inference of mechanistic parameters from omics.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Cosmology methodology unrelated to WCM parameter inference workflows.

plausible.rationale: Sound application of known correlation/cluster statistics.

scalable.rationale: Methods scale across length scales but not to biological complexity.

how_to_validate.rationale: Comparative correlation-function analysis is only weakly relevant to WCM validation.

pipeline-structural-learning.claim_text: ML can propose, evaluate, or refine candidate mechanistic model structures — including organism-scale architecture choices that would be intractable to enumerate by hand.

candidates.paper_title: Data-driven discovery of partial differential equations

useful_outcomes.rationale: Sparse regression discovers governing PDEs from time-series data via Pareto model selection — archetypal ML structure-learning method.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Method (PDE-FIND/SINDy family) has open implementations and is widely re-used.

plausible.rationale: Proven on diverse benchmark systems with parsimony-driven model selection.

scalable.rationale: Effective on canonical PDEs; scaling to genome-wide network structure remains an open challenge.

how_to_validate.rationale: Pareto frontier balancing complexity vs accuracy is a transferable validation strategy.

candidates.paper_title: Machine-guided path sampling to discover mechanisms of molecular self-organization

useful_outcomes.rationale: Autonomous algorithm constructs/validates mechanistic models for self-organization, with symbolic regression for human-interpretable mechanisms.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Targeted at molecular path sampling — useful template, but adapting to WCM needs trajectory-data infrastructure.

plausible.rationale: Validated on ion association, gas hydrates, polymer folding, and membrane assembly cases.

scalable.rationale: Demonstrated for individual self-organization phenomena; whole-cell scaling not shown.

how_to_validate.rationale: Closed-loop validate-and-update of mechanistic models is precisely the validation pattern WCM-builders need.

candidates.paper_title: Robust learning from noisy, incomplete, high-dimensional experimental data via physically constrained symbolic regression

useful_outcomes.rationale: Combines symbolic regression with physical constraints to discover quantitatively accurate models from noisy, incomplete high-dim data.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Method demonstrated on turbulent fluid flow; biological adaptation requires constraint specification.

plausible.rationale: Shows reconstruction of inaccessible variables (pressure, forcing) from velocity-only data — strong methodological evidence.

scalable.rationale: Effective on a single non-equilibrium system; scaling to organism-scale architectures untested.

how_to_validate.rationale: Recovery of held-out latent variables provides a concrete validation protocol.

candidates.paper_title: Discovering a reaction–diffusion model for Alzheimer’s disease by combining PINNs with symbolic regression
candidates.paper_journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

useful_outcomes.rationale: Title indicates discovery of a biological reaction-diffusion model via PINNs+symbolic regression — directly relevant pipeline structure-learning.

immediate_benefit.rationale: PINN+SR pipelines exist in open implementations but adapting to WCM needs effort; abstract not available limits judgment.

plausible.rationale: Plausible from title alone; abstract empty so methodology details cannot be assessed.

scalable.rationale: Reaction-diffusion scope could extend to spatial WCM components, but scaling unclear without abstract.

how_to_validate.rationale: PINN data fitting plus symbolic recovery typically enables in-sample/out-sample validation, but specifics not visible.

candidates.paper_title: Physics-informed learning of governing equations from scarce data

useful_outcomes.rationale: Integrates PINNs with sparse regression to discover nonlinear PDEs from scarce, noisy spatiotemporal data — directly proposes mechanistic structure.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Builds on widely available PINN/SINDy tooling, adoptable for WCM submodel discovery.

plausible.rationale: Combines representation learning, automatic differentiation, and sparse term identification with concrete PDE recoveries.

scalable.rationale: Demonstrated on canonical PDEs; whole-cell scale untested but conceptually extensible.

how_to_validate.rationale: Tests against known governing equations under scarce-data regimes — useful validation pattern.

candidates.paper_title: State estimation of a physical system with unknown governing equations

useful_outcomes.rationale: Approximate Bayesian state estimation simultaneously learns missing model terms and states — directly relevant to refining mechanistic structure.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Variational Markov-Gaussian-process method requires implementation effort; not yet a turnkey tool.

plausible.rationale: Published in Nature; methodologically rigorous reparametrization for stochastic variational inference.

scalable.rationale: Authors note broader applicability beyond state estimation, suggesting scaling potential.

how_to_validate.rationale: Standard state-estimation comparisons available, but no explicit WCM validation playbook.

candidates.paper_title: AI-Aristotle: A physics-informed framework for systems biology gray-box identification

useful_outcomes.rationale: Explicitly identifies parameters and missing physics in systems biology gray-box models via PINN+symbolic regression — direct match for WCM structure refinement.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Framework benchmarked on pharmacokinetic and endocrine models, packaging methods practitioners can adopt.

plausible.rationale: X-TFC + PINN + SR combination is methodologically sound and tested on two systems-biology benchmarks.

scalable.rationale: Domain-decomposition (X-TFC) suggests scaling toward larger biological networks.

how_to_validate.rationale: Systematic accuracy/speed/flexibility/robustness evaluation provides a clear validation template.

candidates.paper_title: Derivative-based SINDy (DSINDy): Addressing the challenge of discovering governing equations from noisy data
candidates.paper_journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

useful_outcomes.rationale: Addresses noisy-data SINDy (governing-equation discovery) — relevant to data-driven mechanistic structure learning.

immediate_benefit.rationale: SINDy variants have open implementations, but abstract empty so adoption specifics uncertain.

plausible.rationale: Title plausible and topic well-grounded, but no abstract to assess methodology depth.

scalable.rationale: SINDy class scales to moderate-sized systems; whole-cell scaling unclear from title alone.

how_to_validate.rationale: SINDy benchmarks typically validate against known equations; specifics not visible.

candidates.paper_title: A Parametric and Feasibility Study for Data Sampling of the Dynamic Mode Decomposition--Range, Resolution, and Universal Convergence States

useful_outcomes.rationale: DMD sampling parametric study on turbulent shear flow — only loosely connected to ML proposing mechanistic structures.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Provides DMD sampling guidance but not a direct WCM structure-discovery tool.

plausible.rationale: Numerical study with concrete simulations; rigor moderate (uncited arXiv).

scalable.rationale: Single-system fluid case offers limited evidence of organism-scale scaling.

how_to_validate.rationale: Sampling-convergence diagnostics give some validation cues for DMD-style learning.

candidates.paper_title: Analytical stable Gaussian soliton supported by a parity-time-symmetric potential with power-law nonlinearity

useful_outcomes.rationale: Analytical soliton stability analysis under PT-symmetric nonlinear potentials — unrelated to ML structure learning for mechanistic models.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Theoretical optical/PT-symmetry physics with no ML pipeline component.

plausible.rationale: Self-contained analytical+numerical stability work, but off-topic for the claim.

scalable.rationale: No relevance to whole-cell complexity.

how_to_validate.rationale: Linear stability + numerical simulation pattern is generic; not specific WCM guidance.
